query: Which vehicle/formulation approaches minimize artifacts in coagulation and immunoassays, and what vehicle/extract control arms are essential?

response.query: Which vehicle/formulation approaches minimize artifacts in coagulation and immunoassays, and what vehicle/extract control arms are essential?
response.answer: Serum and plasma formulations minimize artifacts in coagulation and immunoassays. Water-based extraction controls are essential for comparison.

results.title: Expiring Patents
results.content: Every day patents are expiring. Under the current Patent Act, patents last a maximum of 20 years from the date of filing.
